description: Generate an image, video, or audio clip through SpiderGate's schema-aware pipeline and get back a stored media URL + cost breakdown. `model` is the `<provider>/<model>` id from gate_media_models (e.g. fal/flux-dev, kie/veo-3-fast, openai/tts-1). Put per-model tunables (negative_prompt/seed/guidance_scale/aspect_ratio · duration · voice/speed/format) in `params` — call gate_media_models FIRST to learn which params THIS model declares; undeclared params are dropped. Video can take minutes (synchronous). BYOK: needs the brand's own provider key. Reuse a saved prompt with `prompt` = "prompt:<id>" (stable) or "prompt.<name>" (needs `project_id`): the server expands its stored system/prompt-text + model + settings, and your `params` OVERRIDE them.

params.description: Per-model tunables validated against the model's declared `inputs`. For image: prompt, negative_prompt, seed, guidance_scale, aspect_ratio, num_images. For video: prompt, duration, aspect_ratio, image_url. For TTS: text, voice, speed, format.

project_id.description: Studio project uuid — REQUIRED to resolve a "prompt.<name>" reference (not needed for "prompt:<id>").

prompt.description: Optional saved-prompt reference: "prompt:<public_id>" or "prompt.<name>". Server-expanded; your explicit params/model win. A plain string here is treated as the reference, not literal text.

name: gate_media_generate
